summary: DuckDB's integer AVG depends on plan shape and platform; the DuckDB profile's avg(BIGINT) allows a set of doubles stated over every shape (no fact names a shape). #1675's label held until its texts say so; steps 12d-1/2/3 set. No D-number.
note: Withdraws ruling 71's sentence '12d no longer gates semantics=duckdb on Linux'; ruling 67's remark on the last bit below 2^53 stands again for native shapes.
